40010928.author: पदार्थः
40010928.content: तत्र there, हनुमान् Hanuman, इति thus, उक्त्वा having addressed, पुनः again, कृष्णाजिनाम्बराम् robed in deer skin, महाभागाम् a distinguished lady, धर्मचारिणीम् a righteous woman, तां तापसीम् ascetic woman, अब्रवीत् said.

40010928.author: Translation
40010928.content: On meeting the distinguished, righteous ascetic woman robed in deer skin, Hanuman said:

40010929.author: पदार्थः
40010929.content: क्षुत्पिपासापरिश्रान्ताः exhausted with hunger and thirst, सर्वशः by all means, परिखिन्नाश्च fatigued, तिमिरसंवृतम् filled with darkness, इदम् this, बिलम् cave, सहसा all at once, प्रविष्टाः entered.

40010929.author: Translation
40010929.content: 'We are exhausted with thirst and hunger. We are fatigued. (Hence) we entered this dark cave all at once(without waiting for permission).

40010930.author: पदार्थः
40010930.content: पिपासिताः thirsty, धरण्याः of the earth, महत् huge, विवरम् hole, प्रविष्टाः स्म we entered, एवं विधान् this kind, विविधान् many, अद्भुतोपमान् wonderful ones, इमान् these, भावान् feelings, दृष्ट्वा after seeing, वयम् we, नष्टचेतसः having lost conciousness nearly, सम्भ्रान्ताः amazed, प्रव्यथिताः we are pained.

40010930.author: Translation
40010930.content: 'Thirst drove us into this cave on earth. We are amazed at the kind of many wonderful objects here and have nearly lost our senses. We are tormented with pain.

40010931.author: पदार्थः
40010931.content: एते these, तरुणादित्यसन्निभाः resembling like the rising Sun, काञ्चनाः golden, वृक्षाः trees, शुचीनि pure, अभ्यवहार्याणि very tasty eatables, मूलानि च roots, फलानि च and fruits, काञ्चनानि golden, विमानानि storeyed structures, राजतानि silver, तपनीय गवाक्षाणि glittering golden windows, मणिजालावृतानि adorned with lattices encrusted with gems, गृहाणि च and houses, कस्य whose?

40010931.author: Translation
40010931.content: 'To whom do these golden trees resembling the rising Sun belong? For whom are these  tasty roots and fruits? Whose are these manystoreyed golden houses with glittering windows adorned with silver lattices encrusted with gems?

40010932.author: पदार्थः
40010932.content: एते these, तरुणादित्यसन्निभाः resembling like the rising Sun, काञ्चनाः golden, वृक्षाः trees, शुचीनि pure, अभ्यवहार्याणि very tasty eatables, मूलानि च roots, फलानि च and fruits, काञ्चनानि golden, विमानानि storeyed structures, राजतानि silver, तपनीय गवाक्षाणि glittering golden windows, मणिजालावृतानि adorned with lattices encrusted with gems, गृहाणि च and houses, कस्य whose?

40010932.author: Translation
40010932.content: 'To whom do these golden trees resembling the rising Sun belong? For whom are these  tasty roots and fruits? Whose are these manystoreyed golden houses with glittering windows adorned with silver lattices encrusted with gems?

40010933.author: पदार्थः
40010933.content: पुष्पिताः blossomed, फलवन्तश्च full of fruits, पुण्याः sacred, सुरभिगन्धिनः filled with fragrance, इमे these, जाम्बूनदमयाः full of gold, पादपाः trees, विमले in pure, जले in water, काञ्चनानि of gold, पद्मानि च and lotuses, कस्य whose, तेजसा by lustre, जातानि created, कच्छपैः सह along with tortoises, सौवर्णाः golden, मत्स्याश्च fishes too, कथम् how, आत्मानम् yourself, अनुभावाम् च your power, एतत् all this, तपोबलम् ascetic power, कस्य whose, च and, अजानताम्  do not know, नः us, सर्वेषाम् for all of us, सर्वम् everything, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought to.

40010933.author: Translation
40010933.content: 'By whose prowess are these golden trees yielding sacred fragrant flowers and fruits?  How are these golden lotuses created in the clear water? How is it that here are golden fishes and tortoises? Whose fruit of penance is this? Is it by your power? We do not know. You should tell all of us everything'.

40010934.author: पदार्थः
40010934.content: पुष्पिताः blossomed, फलवन्तश्च full of fruits, पुण्याः sacred, सुरभिगन्धिनः filled with fragrance, इमे these, जाम्बूनदमयाः full of gold, पादपाः trees, विमले in pure, जले in water, काञ्चनानि of gold, पद्मानि च and lotuses, कस्य whose, तेजसा by lustre, जातानि created, कच्छपैः सह along with tortoises, सौवर्णाः golden, मत्स्याश्च fishes too, कथम् how, आत्मानम् yourself, अनुभावाम् च your power, एतत् all this, तपोबलम् ascetic power, कस्य whose, च and, अजानताम्  do not know, नः us, सर्वेषाम् for all of us, सर्वम् everything, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought to.

40010934.author: Translation
40010934.content: 'By whose prowess are these golden trees yielding sacred fragrant flowers and fruits?  How are these golden lotuses created in the clear water? How is it that here are golden fishes and tortoises? Whose fruit of penance is this? Is it by your power? We do not know. You should tell all of us everything'.

40010935.author: पदार्थः
40010935.content: पुष्पिताः blossomed, फलवन्तश्च full of fruits, पुण्याः sacred, सुरभिगन्धिनः filled with fragrance, इमे these, जाम्बूनदमयाः full of gold, पादपाः trees, विमले in pure, जले in water, काञ्चनानि of gold, पद्मानि च and lotuses, कस्य whose, तेजसा by lustre, जातानि created, कच्छपैः सह along with tortoises, सौवर्णाः golden, मत्स्याश्च fishes too, कथम् how, आत्मानम् yourself, अनुभावाम् च your power, एतत् all this, तपोबलम् ascetic power, कस्य whose, च and, अजानताम्  do not know, नः us, सर्वेषाम् for all of us, सर्वम् everything, आख्यातुम् to tell, अर्हसि you ought to.

40010935.author: Translation
40010935.content: 'By whose prowess are these golden trees yielding sacred fragrant flowers and fruits?  How are these golden lotuses created in the clear water? How is it that here are golden fishes and tortoises? Whose fruit of penance is this? Is it by your power? We do not know. You should tell all of us everything'.

40010936.author: पदार्थः
40010936.content: हनुमता Hanuman, एवम् in that way, उक्ता spoken, सर्वभूतहिते in the interest of all beings, रता committed, धर्मचारिणी noble woman, तापसी female ascetic, हनूमन्तम् to Hanuman, प्रत्युवाच replied.

40010936.author: Translation
40010936.content: The noble ascetic committed to the welfare of all beings replied to Hanuman's enquiry:

40010937.author: पदार्थः
40010937.content: वानरर्षभः O bull among monkeys, महातेजाः brilliant, मायावी a deceitful, मयो नाम called Maya, इदम् this, सर्वम् all, काञ्चनं वनम् golden forest, तेन by his, मायया magical power, निर्मितम् created.

40010937.author: Translation
40010937.content: 'O bull among monkeys this golden forest was created by the magical power of a deceitful demon called Maya.

40010938.author: पदार्थः
40010938.content: येन by whomsoever, काञ्चनम् golden, दिव्यम् wonderful, इदम् this, भवनोत्तमम् best of mansions, निर्मितम् constructed, पुरा earlier, दानवमुख्यानाम्  chiefs of demons, विश्वकर्मा Visvakarma, बभूव existed.

40010938.author: Translation
40010938.content: This best of wonderful mansions has been constructed earlier by Visvakarma, the chief (architect) of the demons.

40010939.author: पदार्थः
40010939.content: सः that, वने in the forest, वर्षसहस्राणि for thousands of years, महावने dense forest, तपः penance, तप्त्वा having performed, पितामहात् from the creator Brahma, वरम् boon, औशनसम् of Usanas, सर्वम् all, धनम् wealth, लेभे inherited.

40010939.author: Translation
40010939.content: 'He (Maya) performed rigorous penance in the dense forest for thousands of years seeking the favour of Brahma, the creator and obtained a boon that he should inherit all the wealth of Usanas (Shukra).

40010940.author: पदार्थः
40010940.content: तदा then, बलवान् powerful one, सर्वकामेश्वरः master of all desires, सुखितः happily, अस्मिन् in this, महावने in this dense forest, कञ्चित्कालम् for some time, उवास lived, वनं the forest, विधाय after creating.

40010940.author: Translation
40010940.content: Then the mighty Maya who received the power of (executing) desires created this mansion and lived here happily for some time in this dense forest.

40010941.author: पदार्थः
40010941.content: हेमायाम् Hema, अप्सरसि an apsarasa or angel, सक्तम् infatuated, तम् him, दानवपुङ्गवम् great demon, ईशः lord, पुरन्दरः Indra, अशनिम् thunderbolt, गृह्य after taking, विक्रम्यैव with all his might, जघान attacked.

40010941.author: Translation
40010941.content: 'Seeing this great demon in love with a heavenly apsara (nymph) called Hema, Lord Indra with all his might attacked him with his thunderbolt.

40010942.author: पदार्थः
40010942.content: इदम् thus, उत्तमम् wonderful, वनम् forest, शाश्वता: permanently, कामभोगश्च luxurious life, हिरण्मयम् golden, इदम् this, गृहम् house, ब्रह्मणा creator Brahma, हेमायै to Hema, दत्तम् was given.

40010942.author: Translation
40010942.content: 'Thus this wonderful forest and the golden house with all luxury were given away permanently to Hema by the creator Brahma.

40010943.author: पदार्थः
40010943.content: वानरोत्तम best of monkeys, मेरुसावर्णेः of Meru Sauvarni, दुहिता daughter, स्वयंप्रभा Svayamprabha, अहम् me, तस्याः her, हेमायाः Hema's, इदम् this, भवनम् house, रक्षामिI protect.

40010943.author: Translation
40010943.content: 'O best of monkeys daughter of Meru Sauvarni, I am Svayamprabha (selfilluminator), caretaker of this house of Hema. (Meru Sauvarni is the eleventh  Manu).

40010944.author: पदार्थः
40010944.content: नृत्तगीतविशारदा wellversed in dance and music, हेमा Hema, मम to me, प्रियसखी dear friend, तया as such, दत्तवरा granted a boon, अस्मि I am, उत्तमम् supreme, भवनम् house, रक्षामि I watch this house.

40010944.author: Translation
40010944.content: 'Hema, wellversed in dance and music is a fast friend to me. She granted a boon (that none can resist me) and gave this house of which I am the caretaker.

40010945.author: पदार्थः
40010945.content: कार्यम् mission, किम् what, कस्य वा for what, हेतोः for purpose, कान्ताराणि these forests, प्रपश्यथ you are looking for, दुर्गम् inaccessible, इदम् वनम् this forest, युष्माभिः by all of you, कथम् how, उपलक्षितम् was found?

40010945.author: Translation
40010945.content: 'What is your mission? For what purpose have you come to this inaccessible forest? What are you looking for?How did you find this?

40010946.author: पदार्थः
40010946.content: इमान् these, अभ्यवहार्याणि wonderful eatables, मूलानि च roots, फलानि च and fruits, भुक्त्वा after eating, पानीयम् drink, पीत्वा च taking, मे to me, सर्वम् every thing, वक्तुम् you may tell, अर्हथ you may do so.

40010946.author: Translation
40010946.content: 'Eat these wonderful roots and fruits and have these drinks and then tell me all about you. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये किष्किन्धाकाण्डे एकपञ्चशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends of the fiftyfirst sarga in Kishkindakanda of the first epic, the Holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
